args.text: [lane-wren] Risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers too long: (1) Users are sent to old addresses after a server moves, causing outages. (2) Failover is slow, because traffic keeps going to a dead server. (3) Forged or poisoned answers stay in the cache longer, prolonging the harm.

[lane-wren] Idempotent (safe to repeat) retries matter because networks fail, so a client often cannot tell whether its first request worked. If repeating the request gives the same result as sending it once, the client can retry freely without causing duplicate payments, orders or other double effects.
